method: Original Wasm constructors and virtual tooltip builders executed in a network-disabled Node VM; in-memory research copy exports $22/$25 and observes original $56 inputs. No historical server execution is claimed.

dropMethod.formula: effectiveMobRarity=max(1,mobRarity); lower=petalRarity>effectiveMobRarity ? 1 : thresholds[petalRarity]??1; upper=petalRarity<effectiveMobRarity && petalRarity<4 ? thresholds[petalRarity+1] : 1; probability=pow(1-coefficient+upper*coefficient,30000/denominators[mobRarity])-pow(1-coefficient+lower*coefficient,30000/denominators[mobRarity])
dropMethod.scope: Observed original gallery drop percentages and recovered client calculation, not historical server RNG, allocation or independent-roll verification. Probabilities for separate petal kinds must not be normalized into one exclusive distribution.
